shared_elements: low-relief carving on a flat stone slab
rounded/oval object with a horizontal bar or handle across it (bag- or purse-like form)
repetition of that handled form within the same field
horizontal banding dividing the composition into registers
incised outline contours filled with plain surfaces
justification: The clearest specific correspondence is the repeated rounded object crossed by a horizontal bar, read as a handled bag-like form, which appears twice on the central axis of A and three times in the upper register of B, in both cases set against a banded, register-divided field. Otherwise the two are very different: A is a dense, bilaterally symmetrical vegetal scroll design in fine, polished, evenly modelled relief, while B is a sparse, coarsely pecked pillar populated by animal figures with large empty ground between them.
